blocks.text: Jab system ko heat di jaye to us ki internal energy barhti hai: temperature barhta hai, pressure barhta hai ya halat (state) badalti hai. Agar usi waqt cheez ko phail kar mahol par work karne diya jaye, to darkaar heat Q do kaam karti hai: internal energy ko pehli halat ki U₁ se doosri halat ki U₂ tak le jati hai, aur mahol par work W bhi karti hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar qataren, har ek mein System ka dabba. 1: Heat, positive ka teer system mein: +Q. 2: Heat, negative ka teer system se bahar: -Q. 3: Work, negative ka teer system mein: -W. 4: Work, positive ka teer system se bahar: +W.
blocks.caption: For Your Information (PDF page 126): Heat aur kaam ke nishan (sign conventions) (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: system ko jo heat mile woh positive (+Q), jo heat system de woh negative (−Q). Work ulta hai: system jo work kare (bahar jata teer) woh positive (+W), system par jo work ho (andar aata teer) woh negative (−W). Isi se Q = ΔU + W banta hai.
Is tarah internal energy ki tabdeeli ΔU = U₂ − U₁ ko Q − W kaha jata hai. Yeh har us process ke liye ek hi hai jo do halaton ke darmiyan ho, is liye thermodynamics ka pehla law yun likha jata hai:

blocks.title: Thermodynamics ka pehla law
blocks.text: Kisi bhi thermodynamic process mein jab system ko heat Q di jaye, to yeh energy do jagah jati hai: system ki internal energy ka izafa ΔU, aur system ka apne mahol par kiya hua work W.

items: Conservation ka usool: pehle law ki bunyad energy ka conservation (bachao, yani energy na banti hai na mitti) hai. Energy ek shakal se doosri mein badal sakti hai (jaise chemical potential energy se thermal energy), magar isolated system (jo bahar se kuch na le na de) mein kul energy hamesha utni hi rehti hai.

Har jagah lagu: yeh law sirf mechanical systems par nahi, energy ki har shakal aur har process par lagu hai, jaise chemical reactions, electrical systems aur nuclear reactions. Is se scientists aur engineers energy ki tabdeeliyon ko samajh aur pehle se bata sakte hain.

blocks.text: Pehla law energy ke conservation ka law hi hai: isolated system mein energy kam ya zyada nahi hoti. Yeh samjhata hai ke system ke andar energy kaise ek jagah se doosri jagah jati aur shakal badalti hai, aur yeh usool kabhi nahi tootta ke energy na banai ja sakti hai na khatam ki ja sakti hai. Isi liye kainat (universe) mein energy ka rawaiya samajhne ke liye pehla law bohat aham hai.

Cycle ka pump achhi misal hai. Jab hum handle tezi se chalate hain to pump garam ho jata hai, kyun ke gas par mechanical work hota hai aur us ki internal energy barhti hai. Aisa saada intezam Fig. 6.6 mein hai: cycle ka pump jis ka mooh (outlet) band hai. Band mooh mein laga thermocouple hawa ka temperature dikhata hai. Piston tezi se dhakelne par thermometer temperature barhta dikhata hai, kyun ke hawa ki internal energy barh gayi. Dhakelne wali force hawa par work karti hai, is se hawa ki internal energy barhti hai, jo temperature barhne se nazar aati hai.

blocks.alt: Lakri ke takhte par rakha cycle ka pump. Barrel mein band hawa par Trapped air in pump likha hai; daen taraf handle par Piston pushed in ka teer hai. Baen taraf band outlet par thermocouple ek Millivoltmeter se tar ke zariye jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.6: Band outlet wala cycle pump, thermocouple aur millivoltmeter (kitab ki Figure 6.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Piston tezi se andar dhakelne par band hawa par work hota hai; heat ko bahar nikalne ka waqt nahi milta, is liye hawa ki internal energy aur temperature barhte hain. Thermocouple yeh garmi naap kar millivoltmeter ki sui hila deta hai.

Insaan ka metabolism bhi energy conservation ki misal hai. Insaan aur janwar chalne, daurne ya hilne mein work karte hain, aur work ke liye energy chahiye. Barhne, naye cells banane aur mar chuke purane cells ki jagah naye lane ke liye bhi energy chahiye. Jism ke andar energy badalne wale saare processes metabolism kehlate hain. Pehla law (ΔU = Q − W) insaani jism par lagayein: jism jo work karta hai us se us ki internal energy kam hoti hai. Is liye jism ka temperature, yani internal energy, hamari khurak (food) se qaim rehti hai.

blocks.title: Example 6.2
blocks.problem: Ek bartan mein gas band hai jis par 0.10 m² cross-sectional area ka piston laga hai. Gas ka pressure 8000 N m⁻² par qaim rakha jata hai. Aahista heat dene par piston 4.0 cm oopar jata hai. Phailne ke dauran system ko 42 J heat di jaye to internal energy mein kitni tabdeeli hogi?
steps: Gas ka kiya hua work: W = PΔV = PAΔy
Pehle law se: ΔU = Q − W = 42 J − 32 J = 10 J
blocks.answer: Internal energy 10 J barh jati hai: 42 J heat mein se 32 J work ban gaye aur 10 J gas ke andar reh gaye.

blocks.text: Isothermal process

Isothermal process constant temperature par hota hai, is liye gas par Boyle's law lagu hota hai. Yani gas isothermal tareeqe se phaile ya dabe to process ke dauran us ke pressure aur volume ka hasil-e-zarb (product) constant rehta hai. Agar P₁, V₁ shuru ka pressure aur volume hon aur P₂, V₂ isothermal tabdeeli ke baad ke (Fig. 6.7-a), to
Ideal gas ke molecules ki P.E. zero hai, is liye ideal gas ki internal energy sirf temperature par depend karti hai. Yahan temperature constant hai, is liye ΔU = 0, aur pehla law ban jata hai:

blocks.alt: P-V graph. Hara curve Isotherm (P1, V1, T) se (P2, V2, T) tak girta hai, sath Constant Temperature likha hai. Dashed lakeeren har nuqte ko dabao ki axis par P1, P2 aur volume ki axis par V1, V2 se jorti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.7(a): Isotherm (kitab ki Figure 6.7(a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yani agar gas phail kar bahar work W kare, to isothermal rehne ke liye use utni hi heat Q deni parti hai. Heat ko ek jagah se doosri jagah jane mein waqt lagta hai, is liye temperature constant rakhne ke liye expansion ya compression aahista hona chahiye. Isothermal process ko dikhane wala curve isotherm kehlata hai (Fig. 6.7-a).

blocks.title: Brain Teaser!
blocks.text: Isothermal expansion mein ideal gas ki internal energy constant kyun rehti hai?

blocks.prompt: Brain Teaser: isothermal expansion mein ideal gas ki internal energy constant kyun rehti hai?
blocks.explanation: Ideal gas ke molecules ki potential energy zero hai, is liye us ki internal energy sirf temperature par depend karti hai. Isothermal expansion mein temperature constant rehta hai, is liye ΔU = 0; gas jo work karti hai woh bahar se milne wali heat se poora hota hai (Q = W).

blocks.text: Adiabatic process
Adiabatic process mein system mein na heat aati hai na bahar jati hai. Is liye ΔQ = 0, aur pehla law deta hai:

Yani agar gas phail kar bahar work kare, to yeh work us ke molecules ki internal energy se hota hai, is liye gas ka temperature girta hai. Ulta, adiabatic compression mein gas par work hota hai, is liye gas ka temperature barhta hai.
Adiabatic tabdeeli tab hoti hai jab gas tezi se phaile ya dabe, khaas taur par jab gas insulated (garmi na guzarne dene wale) cylinder mein ho. Adiabatic processes ki misalein:

items: Phate hue tyre se hawa ka tezi se nikalna.
Jis hawa se sound wave guzar rahi ho us ka tezi se phailna aur dabna.

blocks.text: Chunke gas ka temperature constant nahi rehta, tajurbe se yeh rishta milta hai:

Yahan γ (gamma) gas ki constant pressure par molar specific heat aur constant volume par molar specific heat ka ratio (nisbat) hai. Adiabatic process ko dikhane wala curve adiabat kehlata hai (Fig. 6.7-b).

blocks.alt: P-V graph. (P1, V1, T1) se thos magenta curve Adiabat tezi se (P2, V2, T2) tak girta hai. Hara dashed curve Isotherm usi nuqte se shuru ho kar adiabat ke oopar rehta hai. Axes par P1, P2, V1 aur V2 dashed lakeeron se.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.7(b): Adiabat aur isotherm (kitab ki Figure 6.7(b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Adiabatic expansion mein gas apni internal energy se work karti hai, is liye us ka temperature T₁ se gir kar T₂ ho jata hai. Isi liye adiabat isotherm se zyada dhalwan (steep) hai, aur usi volume V₂ par us ka pressure kam hai.

blocks.prompt: Gas 500 J heat jazb karti hai aur 300 J work karti hai. Us ki internal energy kitni badli? Adiabat isotherm se zyada dhalwan kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: ΔU = Q − W = 500 J − 300 J = 200 J (internal energy 200 J barhi). Adiabatic expansion mein pressure do wajah se girta hai: volume barhta hai aur temperature bhi girta hai; isothermal expansion mein sirf volume barhta hai. Is liye adiabat tezi se girta hai: γ 1 se bara hai, to PV^γ = constant mein V barhne par P, PV = constant ke muqable mein zyada tezi se kam hota hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Pehla law: Q = ΔU + W; heat andar +Q, bahar −Q; system ka work +W, system par work −W; yeh energy conservation hai (cycle pump garam hota hai; jism ki internal energy khurak se qaim). Example 6.2: W = 32 J, ΔU = 10 J.

Isothermal: T constant, P₁V₁ = P₂V₂, ΔU = 0, Q = W, aahista, curve isotherm. Adiabatic: ΔQ = 0, W = −ΔU, PV^γ = constant, tez ya insulated (phata tyre, sound wave, badal banna), curve adiabat (zyada dhalwan).
